whisperkit.compute: mel CPU/GPU; encoder and decoder CPU/NeuralEngine (library defaults; device utilization not profiled)

scope: Component pilots with resident Swift and Rust workers. Python only orchestrates the comparison. Not a native production service or browser end-to-end benchmark.
notes: No concurrent inference or native compilation during measured runs. Idle local native servers stayed loaded.
Same 8 recordings/references and fixed input languages; repeated samples are not independent speech.
Native timings include process IPC, WAV file IO for ASR, and loopback HTTP for Rust.
WhisperKit compressed Core ML weights, MLX 4-bit, and native GGML/GGUF weights are not identical.
Translation uses whole reference text, identical production prompt IDs, max 256 tokens, temperature 0, fresh KV per request for every backend. GGUF token IDs were verified against the MLX tokenizer.

Translation successes mean parseable JSON fields, NOT semantic accuracy. Original meeting smoke requirements were applied to saved outputs after inference. Semantic failures do not count as quality passes.
No general human translation score, browser timing, power, peak memory, or isolated Rust orchestration overhead measurement.
